```{r setup, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
# Load the packages and shared helpers used for QC, clustering, and plots.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  cache = TRUE,
  autodep = TRUE,
  cache.comments = FALSE,
  cache.path = file.path(
    here::here("results", "cache", "publication_pipeline"),
    paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(knitr::current_input())), "/")
  )
)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(SeuratExtend)
})

# Load the shared helper functions used below.
publication_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input(), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
source(file.path(publication_dir, "publication_helpers.R"), local = TRUE)
```

```{r get_data}
# Load the merged object if it is not already in memory.

}
```

QC steps
```{r name_samples}
# Add number of genes per UMI for each cell to metadata
merged_seurat$log10GenesPerUMI <- log10(merged_seurat$nFeature_RNA) / log10(merged_seurat$nCount_RNA)

# Mitochondrial Ratio
merged_seurat$mitoRatio <- PercentageFeatureSet(object = merged_seurat, pattern = "^mt-")
merged_seurat$mitoRatio <- merged_seurat@meta.data$mitoRatio / 100

# Create metadata dataframe
metadata <- merged_seurat@meta.data
# Add cell IDs to metadata
metadata$cells <- rownames(metadata)
# Create sample column
metadata$sample <- NA

# Derive the developmental age from each sequencing-folder name.
metadata$sample[which(str_detect(metadata$orig.ident, "p1_"))] <- "p1"
metadata$sample[which(str_detect(metadata$orig.ident, "p3_"))] <- "p3"
metadata$sample[which(str_detect(metadata$orig.ident, "p5_"))] <- "p5"
metadata$sample[which(str_detect(metadata$orig.ident, "p8_"))] <- "p8"
metadata$sample[which(str_detect(metadata$orig.ident, "p15_"))] <- "p15"
metadata$sample[which(str_detect(metadata$orig.ident, "p22_"))] <- "p22"

# Rename columns
metadata <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::rename(seq_folder = orig.ident,
                nUMI = nCount_RNA,
                nGene = nFeature_RNA)

# Add metadata back to Seurat object
merged_seurat@meta.data <- metadata
```

Make the QC plots for the merged data
```{r print_qc_plots, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Build and print the pre-filter QC plots so the starting distributions are visible.
merged_plots <- qc_plots(merged_seurat)
print(merged_plots)
```


```{r filter_QC}
# Filter out low quality cells 
filtered_seurat <- subset(x = merged_seurat, 
                          subset= (nUMI >= 1000) & 
                            (nGene >= 1000) & 
                            (log10GenesPerUMI > 0.80) & 
                            (mitoRatio < 0.20))
```


```{r comparison_plots, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Generate qc plots
filtered_plots <- qc_plots(filtered_seurat)

# Arrange plots side-by-side
p2 <- merged_plots[[2]] | filtered_plots[[2]] 
p3 <- merged_plots[[3]] | filtered_plots[[3]]
p4 <- merged_plots[[4]] | filtered_plots[[4]]
p5 <- merged_plots[[5]] | filtered_plots[[5]]
p6 <- merged_plots[[6]] | filtered_plots[[6]]

p2
p3
p4
p5
p6
```


Plot cells per sample before/after filtering
```{r prepare-filter-counts}
# Combine pre-filter and post-filter metadata so retained cell counts can be compared.
metadata_before <- merged_seurat@meta.data  # full dataset
metadata_after <- filtered_seurat@meta.data  # after filtering
metadata_before$filter_status <- "before"
metadata_after$filter_status <- "after"
combined_metadata <- rbind(metadata_before, metadata_after)

cell_counts <- combined_metadata %>%
  group_by(seq_folder, sample, filter_status) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
cell_counts_wide <- cell_counts %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = filter_status, values_from = n)


cells<- ggplot(cell_counts, aes(x = seq_folder, y = n, fill = sample)) +
  geom_col(data = subset(cell_counts, filter_status == "before"), 
           alpha = 0.3, position = "dodge") +
  geom_col(data = subset(cell_counts, filter_status == "after"), 
           position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(data = cell_counts_wide, 
            aes(y = before, label = after, group = sample), 
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, face="bold")) +
  ggtitle("NCells: Before vs After Filtering")


print(cells)
```

Plot removed cells by sex
```{r summarize-filter-counts}
# Summarize retained cells by age and sex for the QC retention table and plot.
cell_counts_wide <- cell_counts %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = filter_status, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(
    sex = case_when(
      seq_folder %in% c("p15_F_counts","p1_F_2_counts","p1_F_counts","p22_F_2_counts","p22_F_counts","p3_F_counts","p8_R1_counts") ~ "F",
      seq_folder %in% c("p15_R1_counts","p1_M_2_counts","p1_M_counts","p22_M_2_counts","p22_M_counts","p3_M_counts","p5_R1_counts","p5_R2_counts","p8_M_counts") ~ "M",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    sample  = factor(sample, levels = c("p1","p3","p5","p8","p15","p22")),
    removed = pmax(before - after, 0)
  )

offsets <- cell_counts_wide %>%
  arrange(sample, sex, seq_folder) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(sample_offset = cumsum(before) - before) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_data <- bind_rows(
  offsets %>% transmute(sample, seq_folder, sex, status = "removed",
                        n = removed, ymin = sample_offset, ymax = sample_offset + removed),
  offsets %>% transmute(sample, seq_folder, sex, status = "retained",
                        n = after, ymin = sample_offset + removed, ymax = sample_offset + removed + after)
) %>%
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c("removed","retained")))

p_sex <- ggplot(plot_data) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = as.numeric(sample) - 0.4, xmax = as.numeric(sample) + 0.4,
                ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = sex, alpha = status),
            color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = ~subset(.x, status == "retained" & n > 0),
            aes(as.numeric(sample), (ymin + ymax)/2, label = n), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("F" = "#e41a1c", "M" = "#377eb8")) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("removed" = 0.3, "retained" = 1),
                     labels = c("Removed","Retained"), name = "Status") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:6, labels = levels(plot_data$sample)) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y = "N Cells", x = "Age", title = "NCells: Before vs After Filtering")
p_sex
```


Process QC'd seurat
```{r normalize}
# normalize data
filtered_seurat <- NormalizeData(filtered_seurat)
filtered_seurat <- FindVariableFeatures(filtered_seurat, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
filtered_seurat <- ScaleData(filtered_seurat)
```

Decide how many PCs to use
```{r choose_pcs}
# Run PCA and select the number of PCs from the variation cutoffs below.
filtered_seurat <- RunPCA(filtered_seurat)
# Determine percent of variation associated with each PC
# Compare the 90% cumulative-variation cutoff with the point where each PC
# contributes less than 5% of the standard deviation.
pct <- filtered_seurat[["pca"]]@stdev / sum(filtered_seurat[["pca"]]@stdev) * 100
# Calculate cumulative percents for each PC
cumu <- cumsum(pct)
# Find the first PC that satisfies both cutoffs.
co1 <- which(cumu > 90 & pct < 5)[1]
# PC where the percent change in variation between consecutive PCs is less than 0.1%
co2 <- sort(which((pct[1:length(pct) - 1] - pct[2:length(pct)]) > 0.1), decreasing = T)[1] + 1
# Use the smaller of the two PC cutoffs.
pcs <- min(co1, co2)


print(pcs)
```


```{r umap}
# Build the neighbor graph, UMAP embedding, and clusters.
filtered_seurat <- FindNeighbors(filtered_seurat, dims = 1:pcs, reduction = "pca")
filtered_seurat <- RunUMAP(filtered_seurat, dims = 1:pcs, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")
filtered_seurat <- FindClusters(filtered_seurat, resolution = 0.3, cluster.name = "unintegrated_clusters")
```

add batches to the data
```{r add_batch_data}
# Define the batch assignment based on seq_folder
filtered_seurat <- filtered_seurat %>%
  AddMetaData(object = ., metadata = case_when(
    .$seq_folder %in% c("p5_R1_counts", "p5_R2_counts", "p8_R1_counts", "p15_R1_counts") ~ 1,  # Corrected this line
    .$seq_folder %in% c("p1_F_counts", "p1_M_counts", "p3_F_counts", "p3_M_counts", "p8_M_counts", "p15_F_counts", "p22_F_counts", "p22_M_counts") ~ 2,
    .$seq_folder %in% c("p1_F_2_counts", "p1_M_2_counts", "p22_F_2_counts", "p22_M_2_counts") ~ 3,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_  # Default to NA if none of the conditions match
  ), col.name = "Batch")

# Verify the metadata
metadata <- filtered_seurat@meta.data

# Check the distribution of Batch values
batch_distribution <- table(metadata$Batch)
print("Batch distribution:")
print(batch_distribution)

# Check which seq_folder values are assigned to each Batch
batch_assignments <- metadata %>% 
  group_by(seq_folder) %>% 
  summarize(Batch = unique(Batch))

print("Batch assignments for each seq_folder:")
print(batch_assignments)
```

```{r plot_by_batch}
# Plot the embedding by sequencing batch to inspect batch composition.
batch_colors <-c("#23ffff", "#f6c141", "#4169e1") 

batch <- DimPlot(filtered_seurat, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", group.by = c("Batch"), shuffle =T)+
  scale_color_manual(values = batch_colors)+
  theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_blank()
    )
# Add axis labels only to first plot
batch <- batch + theme_umap_arrows(x_label = "UMAP_1",
  y_label = "UMAP_2")
batch
```

```{r plot_by_sample}
# Ensure the 'sample' factor is ordered correctly
filtered_seurat$sample <- factor(filtered_seurat$sample, levels = c("p1", "p3", "p5", "p8", "p15", "p22"))

seq_folder_colors <- c(
  "p5_R1_counts" = "#a02b93",  
  "p5_R2_counts" = "#23ffff",  

  "p8_R1_counts" = "#a02b93",  
  "p8_M_counts" = "#23ffff",  

  "p1_F_counts" = "#a02b93",  
  "p1_M_counts" = "#23ffff",  
  "p1_F_2_counts" = "#f6c141",  
  "p1_M_2_counts" = "#4169e1",  

  "p3_F_counts" = "#a02b93",  
  "p3_M_counts" = "#23ffff", 
  "p3_F_2_counts" = "#f6c141",  
  "p3_M_2_counts" = "#4169e1",  


  "p15_R1_counts" = "#a02b93",  
  "p15_F_counts" = "#23ffff", 

  "p22_F_counts" = "#a02b93",  
  "p22_M_counts" = "#23ffff",  
  "p22_F_2_counts" = "#f6c141",  
  "p22_M_2_counts" = "#4169e1"#,   

)


samples <- levels(filtered_seurat$sample)

plots <- lapply(samples, function(s) {
  p <- DimPlot(filtered_seurat[, filtered_seurat$sample == s],
               reduction = "umap.unintegrated",
               group.by = "seq_folder",
               shuffle = TRUE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = seq_folder_colors) +
    ggtitle(s) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )
  return(p)
})

# Add axis labels only to first plot
plots[[1]] <- plots[[1]] + 
  theme_umap_arrows(x_label = "UMAP_1", y_label = "UMAP_2") 
# Combine with patchwork
p <- wrap_plots(plots, nrow = 1) 
p
```

Join the layers
```{r join_layers}
# Join the Seurat assay layers before saving.
# Store sample labels as plain text
# class after temporarily using a factor to control plot ordering.
filtered_seurat$sample <- as.character(filtered_seurat$sample)
filtered_seurat <- JoinLayers(filtered_seurat)
```


Find markers of each cluster 
```{r cluster_markers}
# Find and optionally save per-cluster markers for interpretation of the whole-tissue object.
resolutions <- "unintegrated_clusters"

for (res in resolutions) {
  cluster_col <- res   # use column name directly
  marker_results <- find_markers(filtered_seurat, cluster_col)
  res_tag <- gsub("\\.", "", as.character(res))
  write.csv(marker_results$markers,
    file.path(marker_output_dir, paste0("allMarkers_Res", res_tag, "_allcells.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(marker_results$top_markers,
    file.path(marker_output_dir, paste0("topMarkers_Res", res_tag, "_allcells.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE)
}
```
